crossRefs.note: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.

translations.web: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.
translations.bsb: Then the maidservants and their children approached and bowed down.
translations.kjv: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
translations.asv: Then the handmaids came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
